notes.title: Luminaria is back after launch! After releasing the game, we’re happy to be back with new updates. Whenever possible, we’ll keep improving Luminaria to bring you more content, more polish, and an experience as bug-free as we can make it. Thank you for being part of this journey.

items.text: We’re opening the doors to a new Art Gallery located on the lower deck of the ship! Take your time to explore it and enjoy all the artwork that brings Luminaria to life.

Inside, you’ll find every piece of game art, plus a very special addition: NPCs created by the community during our Drawing Contest. This space is a celebration of creativity, both ours and yours. Don’t miss it!

notes.title: Three New Abilities That Change Your Runs

items.text: Get ready to rethink your strategies. We’ve added three brand-new abilities that can drastically alter how your runs unfold. New synergies, new decisions, and new ways to face the darkness—each run will feel fresher than ever.

As always, we’ve been hard at work polishing the experience. This update includes multiple bug fixes and general improvements across the board to make Luminaria smoother, more stable, and more enjoyable.
Now with more story and meaning than ever! Face the Dark Captain on the mysterious Wandering Galleon and uncover secrets that will change the course of your adventure.
Characters now have different stats and weapons. Select the hero that best suits your play style and lead the light to victory!
Level entry no longer appears at the bottom of the ship. Now you can travel to different episodes from the new and elegant travel selection panel.
The new sniper ability now shows correctly when leveling up. Adjust your aim and shoot!
Want an even more immersive experience? You can now disable the cursor in the settings menu. This option is experimental, so be patient with potential issues.
Expand your knowledge of the world by collecting notes in Episodes 1, 2, 3, and 4! Each note brings you closer to the hidden truth of Luminaria.
Do you like showing off your achievements? Achievements for Episodes 1, 2, 3, and 4 are now available. Complete your feats and showcase your skills!
You will no longer see multiple Luminous Staffs in the first level. This issue that broke the game has been resolved.
Rotating abilities now work correctly and smoothly for the keyboard. Flow with style!
Added effects before launching all abilities that require considerable aim time, so you know when to release your power.
The Boomerang now has its own light so you always know where it is. We've also updated its description.
This weapon now shoots at bosses as it should. No more failures in your most powerful attacks!
Bosses that spawned right on your position now appear further away to avoid instant damage surprises.
The Episode 3 boss launch now comes with improved effects. More epic than ever!
More money is now given per episode. Additionally, experience and money chests give much more. Riches await you!
The user interface now shows on the screen instead of at the player's feet, improving visibility.
When selecting a character in the lobby, it disappears, preventing duplicates in local mode.
Upon entering a level, the main information screens can be skipped by pressing the "Understood" button.

notes.title: That's all for now, brave luminaires! Sharpen your weapons, charge your steam gadgets, and get ready to sail the Wandering Galleon! May light and steam guide you to glory.

items.text: See you in Luminaria!
New Characters: Welcome Ada and Luka to the party! These new additions are sure to bring a fresh, and... slightly peculiar, vibe to the team.
Enhanced UI: Our user interface has received a makeover! Now, your eyes will enjoy every pixel of information with our sleek new UI.
Boss Cam: Tired of staring in one direction? Our new boss camera will keep you on your toes as you face the biggest threats!

Achievements v2: Achievements are back and more challenging than ever in their version II! Get ready to showcase your skills and unlock those achievements that will either give you a sense of accomplishment... or maybe just make you cry a little.
New Ability - Celestial Fist: Prepare to strike with the power of the cosmos and unleash celestial chaos upon your enemies.
Translation Touch-ups: Some missing translations have been added. Now you can understand what that mysterious NPC was really trying to say.
Save Game Issues: Problems with saving the game have been resolved. You no longer have to fear losing your progress after a long gaming session!
Level Entry Bug: No more issues entering a level without selecting it beforehand. Because, let's admit it, sometimes you just want to go with the flow.
Achievement Bug: The "Achievement Bug" has been squashed. Now, only the true deserving ones will receive the achievements they've earned... hopefully.
Fence Bug: Fences are no longer an impassable barrier for your enemies! We've convinced them it's better not to go through there.
Co-op Skill Deactivation: No more issues with skills in co-op mode! Companions shouldn't steal each other's superpowers... unless it's part of the master plan.

First Player Death Issue: The annoying problem that caused the first player to die to ruin the party for everyone else has been fixed. You can finally keep fighting without blaming Steve for his incompetence!
Camera Switch Bug: Now, the camera won't change for no apparent reason. It's time to stop blaming the other player for your bad positioning!
Miraculous Resurrection Bug: No more miraculous resurrections when falling down a hole! We realized it was a bit... unfair.
Boss Sky Change Bug: The sky will no longer change to day when the boss appears. We know you like surprises, but this was a bit excessive, don't you think?
Performance Enhancement: Additionally, a small performance improvement has been made to the game. Now you can enjoy that smooth gameplay without worrying about FPS drops!
Light Gatling Adjustment: The Light Gatling now automatically targets enemies. After all, who has time to aim in the middle of an epic battle? Let technology do the work for you!

So there you have it, adventurers! This patch is packed with exciting changes that are sure to make your next playthrough even more thrilling... and hopefully, a little less chaotic. Until the next update!

notes.title: New Visual Style for Luminaria Characters

items.text: Now, character movements are much smoother and fluid, providing a greater sense of control and precision to the player. Additionally, with more movement directions, the character's maneuverability is expanded, allowing for more detailed exploration of the game world and quicker responses to challenges that arise. In summary, this change has elevated the overall quality of the game and improved player immersion in the world of Luminaria Dark Echoes.
Now you can enjoy an endless experience in episodes 1 and 2, facing increasingly difficult challenges as you progress without limits.
Work together with your friends and revive in the heat of battle to keep the hope of victory alive!

notes.title: New NPC with Dialogue and Story

items.text: Dive even deeper into the world of Luminaria Dark Echoes with the introduction of a new character who will guide you through its fascinating story.
Prepare to face even more challenging enemies with the addition of the fearsome Suicidals, willing to do whatever it takes to stop you.
Keep an eye on the cooldown time of your abilities with the new user interface, allowing you to plan your moves with precision.
Unlock achievements on Steam as you conquer challenges within the game and prove your worth as a true hero of Luminaria Dark Echoes!
Immerse yourself in the story from the beginning with a fully localized introduction that will immerse you even more in the world of Luminaria.

notes.title: Improvements in Character and Enemy Invulnerability and Pushback

items.text: Refine your strategy with adjustments to invulnerability and pushback, offering a more balanced and satisfying combat experience.
Now you can upgrade your skills seamlessly, maintaining gameplay fluidity while strengthening your character.
Enjoy a smoother experience with adjustments to the user interface and visual bug fixes that ensure total immersion in the world of Luminaria Dark Echoes.
We have made a series of optimizations and bug fixes to ensure optimal performance and a seamless gaming experience.
We deeply appreciate your continued support and hope you enjoy all the new features we have prepared for you in Luminaria Dark Echoes! May the light guide you on your journey to victory!

We are pleased to announce version 0.3 of Luminaria, focused on enhancing and balancing your experience in the first two acts of the game. We have made significant adjustments, added new layers of excitement, and unlocked powerful additions. Here is the complete list of changes!

notes.title: Balance in Final Bosses: Acts I and II

items.text: Act I
Adjustments to attack speed and movement patterns to create a more strategic and thrilling battle. Get ready for an enhanced combat experience!
Act II
New visual and auditory effects for the second boss, increasing the intensity of the battle. Beware of the surprises it brings, now more dazzling than ever!
Unlock the power of the Luminous Sword, a blade imbued with the essence of light. Experience a new form of melee combat with skills and special effects that will dazzle your enemies.
Master technology with the new Turret and Drone abilities. Strategically place turrets for defense and control a drone for a unique perspective of the battlefield. Technology becomes your ally!
Immerse yourself in the visual wonder of Stage 2, now fully finished and adorned with details that will further immerse you in the atmosphere of Luminaria.
We have perfected the game's colliders and layers to ensure a seamless experience and total immersion in the world of Luminaria.
Introducing a variety of new enemies that will challenge your combat skills and tactics. Get ready to face even more formidable creatures!
We have redesigned the shield ability to provide better tactical defense. Now, the shield responds more intuitively and strategically to enemy attacks.
We have dedicated time to eliminate pesky bugs that could have affected your gaming experience. Thanks to the community for their detailed reports!
We appreciate all adventurers for their continued support! With these changes, we hope you enjoy the Luminaria experience even more. May the light guide you on your journey!
Hello, Luminaria adventurers!

We're here with an update that will have you laughing while battling monsters (and not battling game bugs)! We've been working harder than a wizard in a spell marathon to enhance your gaming experience, and here are the details of version 0.2:
Bugs Begone!

We've bid farewell to those pesky bugs that made the game as thrilling as counting sheep. Thanks for your reports, community! Now, the only thing that should furrow your brow is focusing on the battle.
Final Boss: The Conductor of Chaos

We've equipped the first final boss with new tricks up its sleeve. It now looks like it's conducting an orchestra of chaos! Get ready for wild moves and attacks as unexpected as a unicorn on a dance floor. Good luck dancing to the rhythm of chaos!
Store Discounts!
We've balanced the prices in the store.
We've enhanced the game's performance so that the only thing freezing is your ice cream, not your screen.
We've added small visual and auditory touches because we believe every game should have at least one confetti explosion.
We appreciate everyone for their laughs and feedback! We hope you enjoy this new version of Luminaria, now with 110% more laughter and fun! May luck be on your side!
